traits.habitat_notes: Marly shores, fens, drainage tracks in peat bogs (FNA).

taxon.note: Scientific and common names as the spec's authors wrote them, and the genus the scientific name is written in.

growth_form.note: The growth form chosen from the plant's habit: an upright rosette of long-stalked, narrowly spatulate blades covered in red, dew-tipped tentacles, with a leafless scape of white flowers.

growth.note: The growth plan (years, step, keyframes) chosen for growing and rendering, not a botanical fact.

variants.note: The environments, conditions and seeds chosen for growing and rendering, not a botanical fact.

taxon.family.note: WCVP v16's family for the accepted name.

taxon.plant_name_id.note: WCVP v16's plant_name_id for the accepted species.

allometry.note: 0.2 m tall at 3 years in the open, inside the floras' range of heights, as grown. Replace with measured data before calling this species calibrated.

appearance.note: Every look comes from the characters through the library's rules: an upright rosette of long-stalked, narrowly spatulate blades covered in red, dew-tipped tentacles, with a leafless scape of white flowers.

traits.library_form.note: As for round-leaved sundew, no other value having been found for Drosera anglica: Flora of North America vol. 6 (2015), Drosera rotundifolia (eFloras, read 2026-10-19): a small perennial rosette herb: forb.

traits.life_span.note: As for round-leaved sundew, no other value having been found for Drosera anglica: Flora of China vol. 8 (2001), Drosera rotundifolia (eFloras, read 2026-10-19): herbs perennial.

traits.woodiness.note: As for round-leaved sundew, no other value having been found for Drosera anglica: Flora of North America vol. 6 (2015), Droseraceae family account (eFloras, read 2026-10-19): herbs.

traits.leaf_habit.note: As for round-leaved sundew, no other value having been found for Drosera anglica: Flora of North America vol. 6 (2015), Drosera rotundifolia (eFloras, read 2026-10-19): plants form winter hibernaculae (Wikipedia: a bud of tightly curled leaves at ground level); the summer rosette dies back.

traits.rosette.note: As for round-leaved sundew, no other value having been found for Drosera anglica: Flora of China vol. 8 (2001), Drosera rotundifolia (eFloras, read 2026-10-19): leaves basal, dense, long-petiolate.

traits.cauline_leaves.note: As for round-leaved sundew, no other value having been found for Drosera anglica: Flora of North America vol. 6 (2015), Drosera rotundifolia (eFloras, read 2026-10-19): scapes 5-35 cm, glabrous (leafless).

traits.height_typical_m.note: Flora of North America vol. 6 (2015), Drosera anglica (eFloras taxon 250101266, read 2026-10-19): scapes 3-25 cm, glabrous; Wikipedia peduncles 6-18 cm, the usual range.

traits.height_max_m.note: Flora of North America vol. 6 (2015), Drosera anglica (eFloras taxon 250101266, read 2026-10-19): scapes to 25 cm.

traits.crown_width_max_m.note: Flora of North America vol. 6 (2015), Drosera anglica (eFloras taxon 250101266, read 2026-10-19): rosettes 2-6 cm diam.; erect leaves to 12 cm spread a little wider (the model's).

traits.stem_length_m.note: As for round-leaved sundew, no other value having been found for Drosera anglica: Flora of North America vol. 6 (2015), Drosera (eFloras, read 2026-10-19): stems 1-2 cm; FOC: stem short, to 5 cm when growing up through Sphagnum.

traits.leaf_arrangement.note: As for round-leaved sundew, no other value having been found for Drosera anglica: Flora of China vol. 8 (2001), Droseraceae family account (eFloras, read 2026-10-19): leaves basal and rosulate (spirally set).

traits.phyllotaxis_pattern.note: As for round-leaved sundew, no other value having been found for Drosera anglica: Flora of China vol. 8 (2001), Droseraceae family account (eFloras, read 2026-10-19): rosulate basal leaves; spiral as in the order's default.

traits.leaf_posture.note: Flora of North America vol. 6 (2015), Drosera anglica (eFloras taxon 250101266, read 2026-10-19): leaves erect; Darwin p.278 'stand almost erect'; Wikipedia 'semi-erect'.

traits.leaf_shape.note: Flora of North America vol. 6 (2015), Drosera anglica (eFloras taxon 250101266, read 2026-10-19): blade obovate to elongate-spatulate; Darwin p.278: 'gradually widen from the footstalk to the bluntly pointed apex'.

traits.leaf_length_m.note: Flora of North America vol. 6 (2015), Drosera anglica (eFloras taxon 250101266, read 2026-10-19): blade 1.5-3.5(-5) cm x 3-7 mm.

traits.leaf_width_m.note: Flora of North America vol. 6 (2015), Drosera anglica (eFloras taxon 250101266, read 2026-10-19): blade 3-7 mm wide.

traits.petiole_length_m.note: Flora of North America vol. 6 (2015), Drosera anglica (eFloras taxon 250101266, read 2026-10-19): petiole differentiated from blade, 3-7 cm.

traits.leaf_margin.note: As for round-leaved sundew, no other value having been found for Drosera anglica: Flora of North America vol. 6 (2015), Drosera (eFloras, read 2026-10-19): blades unlobed; margin fringed only by the stalked glands.

traits.stipules.note: As for round-leaved sundew, no other value having been found for Drosera anglica: Flora of North America vol. 6 (2015), Drosera rotundifolia (eFloras, read 2026-10-19): stipules adnate to the petiole for their whole length, 4-6 mm, fringed along the distal half; FOC 5-7-fid, 6-8 mm, scarious.

traits.glandular_hairs.note: As for round-leaved sundew, no other value having been found for Drosera anglica: Flora of China vol. 8 (2001), Drosera rotundifolia (eFloras, read 2026-10-19): leaf blades with red, long, capitate, sticky glandular hairs; Wikipedia: the upper surface densely covered.

traits.glandular_hair_length_m.note: A model estimate: no length is measured for D. anglica; Darwin p.279: its tentacles 'behave like those of Drosera rotundifolia'; the central tentacles of D. intermedia, of the same section, are 0.46-0.91 mm (Kozak et al. 2026).

traits.hair_colour.note: Wikipedia, Drosera anglica (read 2026-10-19): 'stalked reddish colored mucilaginous glands'.

traits.leaf_colour.note: Wikipedia, Drosera anglica (read 2026-10-19): 'Plants are green, coloring red in bright light'.

traits.vernation.note: As for round-leaved sundew, no other value having been found for Drosera anglica: Flora of China vol. 8 (2001), Droseraceae family account (eFloras, read 2026-10-19): juvenile leaf blade circinate.

traits.inflorescence.note: As for round-leaved sundew, no other value having been found for Drosera anglica: Flora of China vol. 8 (2001), Drosera rotundifolia (eFloras, read 2026-10-19): cincinni 1 or 2, 3-30-flowered (one-sided coiled cymes); Wikipedia: flowers on one side of a single slender stalk.

traits.inflorescence_posture.note: As for round-leaved sundew, no other value having been found for Drosera anglica: Flora of China vol. 8 (2001), Drosera rotundifolia (eFloras, read 2026-10-19): inflorescences erect, scapiform, slender.

traits.units_per_inflorescence.note: Flora of North America vol. 6 (2015), Drosera anglica (eFloras taxon 250101266, read 2026-10-19): inflorescences 1-12-flowered.

traits.peduncle_length_m.note: Flora of North America vol. 6 (2015), Drosera anglica (eFloras taxon 250101266, read 2026-10-19): scapes 3-25 cm.

traits.inflorescence_length_m.note: As for round-leaved sundew, no other value having been found for Drosera anglica: A model estimate (confidence low), as no source read gives it: the coiled flowering tip of the scape uncurls to about 2-6 cm with its 2-15 flowers on 1-3 mm pedicels.

traits.pedicel_length_m.note: As for round-leaved sundew, no other value having been found for Drosera anglica: Flora of China vol. 8 (2001), Drosera rotundifolia (eFloras, read 2026-10-19): pedicels 1-3 mm.

traits.flower_size_m.note: Flora of North America vol. 6 (2015), Drosera anglica (eFloras taxon 250101266, read 2026-10-19): flowers 8-10 mm diam.

traits.flower_merosity.note: As for round-leaved sundew, no other value having been found for Drosera anglica: Flora of China vol. 8 (2001), Drosera rotundifolia (eFloras, read 2026-10-19): sepals 5, petals 5 (Wikipedia five-petalled).

traits.perianth.note: As for round-leaved sundew, no other value having been found for Drosera anglica: Flora of China vol. 8 (2001), Drosera rotundifolia (eFloras, read 2026-10-19): sepals 5, petals 5.

traits.sepal_length_m.note: Flora of North America vol. 6 (2015), Drosera anglica (eFloras taxon 250101266, read 2026-10-19): sepals oblong, 5-6 x 4-5 mm.

traits.petal_length_m.note: Flora of North America vol. 6 (2015), Drosera anglica (eFloras taxon 250101266, read 2026-10-19): petals usually white, rarely pinkish, spatulate, 5-6 x 2-3.5 mm.

traits.petal_shape.note: As for round-leaved sundew, no other value having been found for Drosera anglica: Flora of North America vol. 6 (2015), Drosera rotundifolia (eFloras, read 2026-10-19): petals spatulate.

traits.flower_colour.note: Flora of North America vol. 6 (2015), Drosera anglica (eFloras taxon 250101266, read 2026-10-19): petals usually white, rarely pinkish.

traits.calyx_colour.note: As for round-leaved sundew, no other value having been found for Drosera anglica: Flora of China vol. 8 (2001), Drosera rotundifolia (eFloras, read 2026-10-19): sepals green, glandular; sRGB by eye for the word.

traits.stamens.note: As for round-leaved sundew, no other value having been found for Drosera anglica: Flora of China vol. 8 (2001), Drosera rotundifolia (eFloras, read 2026-10-19): stamens 5, 4-5 mm.

traits.stamen_length_m.note: As for round-leaved sundew, no other value having been found for Drosera anglica: Flora of China vol. 8 (2001), Drosera rotundifolia (eFloras, read 2026-10-19): stamens 4-5 mm.

traits.carpels.note: As for round-leaved sundew, no other value having been found for Drosera anglica: Flora of China vol. 8 (2001), Drosera rotundifolia (eFloras, read 2026-10-19): placentas 3; styles 3 or 4, deeply parted.

traits.fruit_type.note: As for round-leaved sundew, no other value having been found for Drosera anglica: Flora of North America vol. 6 (2015), Drosera rotundifolia (eFloras, read 2026-10-19): capsules 5 mm.

traits.fruit_size_m.note: Flora of North America vol. 6 (2015), Drosera anglica (eFloras taxon 250101266, read 2026-10-19): capsules 4-6 mm.

traits.capsule_valves.note: As for round-leaved sundew, no other value having been found for Drosera anglica: Flora of China vol. 8 (2001), Drosera rotundifolia (eFloras, read 2026-10-19): capsule 3- or 4-valved.

traits.fruit_colour_ripe.note: As for round-leaved sundew, no other value having been found for Drosera anglica: A model estimate (confidence low), as no source read gives it: a ripe dry capsule pale brown, inside the persistent withered sepals and petals; sRGB by eye.

traits.flowering_months.note: Flora of North America vol. 6 (2015), Drosera anglica (eFloras taxon 250101266, read 2026-10-19): flowering Jun-Aug.

traits.fruiting_months.note: A model estimate: flowering (FNA Jun-Aug) shifted a month later; FNA gives no fruiting time.

traits.leaf_out_months.note: As for round-leaved sundew, no other value having been found for Drosera anglica: A model estimate (confidence medium), as no source read gives it: rosettes unfold from the hibernaculum in spring after snowmelt, April-May.

traits.leaf_fall_months.note: As for round-leaved sundew, no other value having been found for Drosera anglica: A model estimate (confidence medium), as no source read gives it: summer leaves die back as the hibernaculum forms in autumn, September-October.

traits.elevation_min_m.note: Flora of North America vol. 6 (2015), Drosera anglica (eFloras taxon 250101266, read 2026-10-19): 10-2600 m.

traits.elevation_max_m.note: Flora of North America vol. 6 (2015), Drosera anglica (eFloras taxon 250101266, read 2026-10-19): 10-2600 m.

traits.light.note: As for round-leaved sundew, no other value having been found for Drosera anglica: Flora of North America vol. 6 (2015), Drosera (eFloras, read 2026-10-19): leaves red in strong sunlight, greener in shade; FOC forest understories and wet sunny open areas.

traits.moisture.note: As for round-leaved sundew, no other value having been found for Drosera anglica: Flora of North America vol. 6 (2015), Drosera rotundifolia (eFloras, read 2026-10-19): Sphagnum bogs, fens, swamps, wet sand, seeps.

traits.soil_texture.note: As for round-leaved sundew, no other value having been found for Drosera anglica: Flora of North America vol. 6 (2015), Drosera rotundifolia (eFloras, read 2026-10-19): peaty gravels, sandy soil, wet sand (peat, the commonest substrate, has no state).

traits.habitat_notes.note: Flora of North America vol. 6 (2015), Drosera anglica (eFloras taxon 250101266, read 2026-10-19): marly shores, fens, drainage tracks in peat bogs.

traits.rosette_leaves.note: As for round-leaved sundew, no other value having been found for Drosera anglica: A model estimate (confidence medium), as no source read counts it: a rosette 2-10 cm across of long-stalked leaves.

traits.flowering_stems.note: As for round-leaved sundew, no other value having been found for Drosera anglica: Wikipedia, Drosera rotundifolia (read 2026-10-19): a single flowering stalk from the centre of the rosette.

traits.marginal_gland_length_m.note: A model estimate: the marginal tentacles of D. intermedia, 1.6-3.2 mm (Kozak et al. 2026); none measured for D. anglica.

traits.glandular_hairs_per_cm2.note: A model estimate: no count found for D. anglica; Darwin's 192 on a round-leaved sundew's blade, about 400 to the square centimetre, thinned a little for the longer blade (FNA 15-35 x 3-7 mm): 300 to the square centimetre, 200 to 400 a leaf.

traits.gland_head_diameter_m.note: Darwin, Insectivorous Plants (1875), p.278: 'The glands of all the tentacles have the same structure' as in D. rotundifolia (0.20 mm long, p.6).

traits.gland_drop_diameter_m.note: A model estimate: Wikipedia, Drosera anglica (read 2026-10-19): glands 'each tipped with a clear droplet of a viscous fluid'; the drop's width as for round-leaved sundew (1.5 to 3 times the gland's).

traits.gland_secretion.note: Wikipedia, Drosera anglica (read 2026-10-19): 'each tipped with a clear droplet of a viscous fluid'.

traits.gland_stalk_colour.note: Wikipedia, Drosera anglica (read 2026-10-19): 'stalked reddish colored mucilaginous glands'.
